newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold ends down on overseas selling.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends down on overseas selling.

text.p: Hong Kong gold closed lower on Tuesday after late selling from overseas, reversing its rebound in New York overnight, dealers said.
Bullion ended at US$345.30/80 an ounce against New York's US$346.40/90 close on Monday and Hong Kong's previous close of $344.50/345.00.

"Gold fell in the afternoon session in response to the U.S. dollar rising to above 122 against the yen and 1.64 against the mark," said a dealer at a major bank. "But gold recovered and held at above US$345, where it found solid support."
Gold would range-trade between $345 and $350 in the short term, dealers said.
The local tael market was closed for the Chinese New Year holiday and will reopen on February 10.
